report_text:
Performance/security issue report.

    We use ansi-regex 5.0.0 (through chalk's dependency tree) to strip
    control sequences from log lines before storing them. One log line
    from an untrusted source with a long sequence of escape-like
    characters caused our ingest worker to peg CPU for minutes. It looks
    like the regex used to find escape sequences backtracks on that input.

    Claim: ansi-regex 5.0.0 is vulnerable to ReDoS when stripping a
    crafted string; 5.0.1 should fix it. We have a CPU profile showing
    the hot path in the regex engine but not the input string itself
    (it contains customer data).
source_note:
Real public vulnerability (CVE-2021-3807, ansi-regex ReDoS) reworded
    into end-user report style for the E2 suite. No exploit included.
    Public vulnerability; used for evaluation only.
